summary: @servicetitan/startup-utils preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall='node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip, extracts it, chmods the binary 0o755, and execFileSyncs it against sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line Bun-compiled CJS bundle marked '// @bun @bun-cjs' with hex-obfuscated identifiers (_0xNNNN-style) and a shuffled string-array rotator (WV8StW/n7gIxM), invoked only via the freshly downloaded Bun binary. The advertised library surface in dist/index.js exports only small helpers (get-version-mismatches, is-compatible) and never references math_init.js. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install to execute an obfuscated 727 KB payload that is unrelated to the declared utility API is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: it executes attacker-controlled code on every installer's machine and evades Node-only scanners. The @servicetitan scope framing plus a bolted-on preinstall dropper is consistent with a scope hijack / malicious publish rather than a legitimate release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
